admission.justification: Instruction-only setup and automatic worktree-start setup were weighed; the measurement threshold governs when the deferred implementation may be reopened.

alternatives.option: Document setup at intake and after lock-changing syncs in repository tool notes, with generic role pointers.
alternatives.reason: Use the existing mechanism with minimal product changes, then measure whether the instruction reaches every new task.

alternatives.option: Build the environment as an automatic step of worktree_start now.
alternatives.reason: The requirement explicitly excludes automation until the instruction has been measured.
alternatives.reconsider_when: Fewer than ten of the first ten task starts after landing have a local environment before their first candidate command.

consequences: The Manager records the next ten starts; failure returns to the Architect for an automation task.
Candidate commands do not fall back to the primary interpreter when setup fails.
context: Candidate commands can import primary-checkout source on a borrowed environment, while the existing worktree-local bootstrap already provides the required mechanism.
decider: Developer D209 as approved in MIK-R136@v1; measurement and exclusions in rules 8 and Scope.
